## bambu-studio-ai v0.20.1

- Documentation updates in README.md and SKILL.md.
- No functional or code changes; maintenance release to improve clarity and setup instructions.

Version 0.20.0 adds slicing workflow support and expands printer info/notification features.

- Added `scripts/slice.py` for model slicing, with options for orientation, arrangement, quality presets, printer/nozzle selection, and profile listing.
- Updated Quick Reference with new slice commands and detection triggers (e.g., "slice this", "what nozzle is installed?").
- Expanded detection triggers and Quick Reference with printer hardware info (`bambu.py info`) and notification support (`bambu.py notify`).
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and README.md for new commands and triggers.
- Internal updates across scripts to support slicing integration and expanded CLI options.
Fix: mesh.split() timeout protection (30s SIGALRM) — prevents infinite hang on complex lattice topologies like Eiffel Tower. Found via 50-model stress test.

3-round audit: 17 bug fixes (B1-B17), color pipeline overhaul (AO delight, shadow-aware border vote, --no_delight flag), search rewrite (ddgs replacing broken DDG HTML), doctor.py cloud API + search backend checks, monitor retry logic + offline --status, _finalize STL/OBJ magic bytes detection, dead code cleanup, docs updated (SKILL.md + README)
13 security/stability fixes (P0-P2), doctor.py self-check, cross-platform support, 3 test-discovered bugs fixed
NEW: Model search across MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse, Thangs (no API keys needed). NEW: Notification system (macOS + file log for agent pickup). search.py 145 lines.
Default to LAN mode (was cloud). Clear error when cloud credentials missing. Auto-create output/models directory.
Fix: bambulabs-api method compat shims (set_speed_level↔set_print_speed, get_ams↔ams_hub). Add requirements.txt with version bounds. Add request timeouts to all HTTP calls.
Default to Bambu Lab official palette (43 colors). Direct nearest-neighbor mapping for >20 colors (skips K-means). Auto-adjust cluster count for medium palettes.
